mapper.select:
select t1.* from TBL_CEA_EXPATRIATE_APPLY t1 left join TBL_STAFF t2 on t2.STAFFID = t1.APPLYPEOPLE left join TBL_ORGANIZATION t3 on t3.ORGID = t1.APPLYWORKUNIT where 1=1 and (t1.creator = #{param.creator}
or t1.creator in (SELECT DISTINCT STAFFID FROM TBL_USER_ORGRELATION WHERE DEPTID IN (${param.getDeptIds})) )
and t2.REALNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.applyPeopleName},'%'))
and t3.ORGNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.applyWorkUnitName},'%'))
order by t1.id desc

select t1.* from TBL_CEA_EXPATRIATE_APPLY t1 left join TBL_STAFF t2 on t1.APPLYPEOPLE=t2.STAFFID left join TBL_ORGANIZATION t4 on t4.ORGID = t2.ORGID where t1.STATE = 6 and not exists(select * from TBL_CEA_CANCEL_HOLIDAY t2 where t2.RELATIONID = t1.ID and t2.STATE = 6)
AND t2.REALNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.realName},'%'))
and t4.ORGNAME like concat('%',concat(#{param.applyWorkUnitName},'%'))
and t1.ID in
#{item}
order by t1.id desc
